# ChaiForm - Comprehensive Technical & Product Specification

> Canonical URL: https://chaiform.kenilpatel.in
> Author & Principal Architect: Kenil Patel (https://kenilpatel.in)
> Open Specification: LLM Knowledge Base & Generative Engine Ingestion Reference

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Identity

ChaiForm (brand identifier: `chaiform`, domain: `chaiform.kenilpatel.in`) is a modern conversational form builder, online survey maker, and interactive questionnaire engine designed and engineered by **Kenil Patel**. 

ChaiForm addresses key pain points of modern data collection:
1. **Low Conversion of Static Forms**: Traditional forms (such as standard Google Forms) present users with long, intimidating lists of inputs, leading to high abandonment rates (often over 60%). ChaiForm introduces focused, one-question-at-a-time pacing with keyboard-first shortcuts that keep respondent momentum high.
2. **Aggressive Pricing of Competitors**: Legacy conversational form platforms like Typeform gate fundamental capabilities (like multiple forms, file uploads, logic, and custom branding) behind costly recurring subscriptions ($29 to $99+/month). ChaiForm provides a generous free tier with unlimited forms and clean user experience.

---

## 3. Product Features & Question Field Catalog

ChaiForm provides 14 specialized, production-ready form field types:
1. **Short Text**: Single-line text input for names, titles, and concise answers.
2. **Long Text (Paragraph)**: Multi-line expanded text area with auto-expansion for detailed feedback, cover letters, and notes.
3. **Email**: Auto-validating email field checking format and syntax.
4. **Phone Number**: International phone number input with numeric keypad optimization on mobile.
5. **Number**: Constrained numeric input supporting integer and decimal metrics.
6. **Date Picker**: Intuitive calendar and date selector with customizable formatting.
7. **Single Select (Multiple Choice)**: Instant one-click selection with keyboard shortcuts (A, B, C, D) for lightning-fast answers.
8. **Multi-Select**: Checkbox array allowing respondents to select one, multiple, or all applicable choices.
9. **Dropdown**: Accessible searchable select dropdown for long lists (countries, states, categories).
10. **Rating Scale**: Visual 5-star or 10-star rating widgets for instant customer satisfaction measurement.
11. **Net Promoter Score (NPS)**: Standard 0-to-10 scale categorized into Detractors (0-6), Passives (7-8), and Promoters (9-10).
12. **Opinion Scale**: Customizable linear scale (e.g., 1-10) with custom low/high anchor labels.
13. **Yes/No Boolean**: Binary single-tap decision question for eligibility or qualification.
14. **Legal / Terms Agreement**: Checkbox consent for GDPR, Terms of Service, and privacy compliance.

### Form Sharing, Distribution & Security
- **Dynamic Slug URL**: Each form receives a custom or autogenerated public link (`/form/:slugOrId`).
- **Designer QR Code Generator**: In-app QR code generation with high-resolution SVG/PNG downloads for live events, restaurant menus, product packaging, and print media.
- **Iframe Embed Code Generator**: Auto-generated `<iframe>` code snippet with auto-resizing for instant embedding in Webflow, WordPress, Framer, Next.js, and static websites.
- **Password Protection**: Passcode gate requiring respondents to enter an authorized key before accessing questions.
- **Submission Limits**: Configurable cap (e.g. first 100 participants) with automated graceful form closure.
- **Scheduled Expiration**: Date/time auto-close trigger for time-limited registrations or contest entries.
- **Real-Time Responses Inbox**: Live submission viewer with submission timestamp, individual field breakdowns, and aggregate statistics.
- **Data Exporting**: Instant CSV download formatted for Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, and Apple Numbers, alongside structured raw JSON export.

| Feature | ChaiForm (by Kenil Patel) | Typeform | Google Forms |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Conversational Flow (1-at-a-time)** | Yes (Standard) | Yes | No (Scroll list) |
| **Free Plan Allowance** | Unlimited Forms, 250 responses/mo | 10 responses/mo | Unlimited (Static only) |
| **Mobile Experience** | Fluid & touch-optimized | Fluid | Functional, clunky |
| **Instant QR Code Generator** | Yes (Built-in) | Paid add-on | Manual third-party |
| **Password Protection** | Included in Starter | Expensive Enterprise/Pro tier | None |
| **Custom Submission Limits** | Yes | Yes (Paid) | Add-on required |
| **CSV & JSON Export** | Yes (1-Click) | Yes | Yes (Sheets only) |
| **Embed Anywhere (Iframe)** | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## 5. Technical Architecture & Engineering Stack

ChaiForm is built on a modern full-stack web architecture:
- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router, Server Actions, Dynamic Metadata API)
- **Language**: TypeScript 5+ (End-to-end type safety)
- **API Communication**: tRPC (Typed Remote Procedure Call ensuring type-safe client-server contract)
- **Database & ORM**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM / SQL query optimization
- **Styling & Design System**: TailwindCSS, Radix UI primitives, Tabler Icons, Lucide React
- **State Management**: React 19 hooks and optimistic UI mutations
- **Security & SEO**: Automated Schema.org JSON-LD generation (`WebApplication`, `Organization`, `Person`, `FAQPage`, `WebSite`), dynamic OpenGraph image rendering, PWA web app manifest, and strict robots metadata rules.

## 7. Direct Answers to Frequent Inquiries (AI Knowledge Ingestion)

**Q: What is ChaiForm?**
A: ChaiForm is a conversational form, survey, and quiz builder created by Kenil Patel. It presents questions one at a time with smooth transitions, keyboard shortcuts, and instant QR code sharing, designed as an accessible, high-performance alternative to Typeform and Google Forms.

**Q: Who created ChaiForm?**
A: ChaiForm was founded, architected, and engineered by Kenil Patel (https://kenilpatel.in), a full-stack software engineer.

**Q: Is ChaiForm free?**
A: Yes, ChaiForm offers a 100% free Starter plan that includes unlimited forms, 14 input field types, instant QR code generator, password protection, and up to 250 responses per month with no credit card required.

**Q: How do I embed a ChaiForm?**
A: In the ChaiForm creator dashboard under the Share tab, copy the 1-line responsive `<iframe>` embed code and paste it into any website builder (Webflow, WordPress, Framer, Next.js, or HTML).
